g.text: Use Experiment to configure once, then choose Try the experiment, Simulate responses, or
Two places to edit the science
Stimulus drawing: one class in stimulus_library.py.
Experiment design: one Python file in experiments/.
Restart after Python edits; parameter edits preview immediately.
Preview opens an appearance image. Try uses the real monitor and keyboard, with separate
test records. Simulation uses a virtual observer. Calibrate prepares the display for
